newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin falls nine cents, tracks LME drop.
newsitem.headline: KL tin falls nine cents, tracks LME drop.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price fell nine cents to 13.76 ringgit ($5.23) a kg on Wednesday, tracking an overnight drop on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
Tin price in London fell to a fresh 2-1/2 year low on Tuesday on further selling of the metal.
Traders said a weak ringgit against the U.S. dollar helped limit the price fall here.
"Ringgit remains weak and this helps to narrow the premium over LME," said one trader. The local price premium against the LME was now at $5 a tonne from $35 on Tuesday, he said.
Traders said the performance of LME would continue to influence price direction here.
Traders noted initial bids for 59 tonnes against offers for 133.
Final turnover was 113 tonnes, up from 77 on Tuesday, and was again absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
